test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A book needs to be typed. When working alone, A types it in 15 days, B types it in 12 days, C types it in 20 days, and D types it in 8 days. If A and D work together as team SUN, B and C work as team MOON, and A and C work as team RED. Which team finishes typing the book in the least time?
solution:
**Given:**

A types the book in 15 days

B types the book in 12 days

C types the book in 20 days

D types the book in 8 days

Team SUN: A and D

Team MOON: B and C

Team RED: A and C

**Formula used:**

Work rate of team = Sum of individual work rates

Work rate = 1/Time taken

Time taken = 1/Work rate

**Calculation:**

Work rate of A = 1/15

Work rate of B = 1/12

Work rate of C = 1
